lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Stephen Rosales is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Stephen is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Thornfield watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d41: 🕯️ Stephen Rosales is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Stephen kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
